_comment: Grow's paths, hand-written. A ruling's `arabic` is the scholar's sentence copied from the book, never paraphrased: tests/test_grow.py checks each one against the book's own file. A ruling from a hadith names its sunnah.com page in `where`, and the test checks it against hadith-sources.json, which holds the hadith as sunnah.com prints it, vowels and all. A step with no clear sentence in the book carries no ruling. A path names its tier (grow.json lists the tiers) and cuts its steps into groups: a group is one node on the map, `icon` names its picture, and every step sits in exactly one group.

steps.title: Make the intention
steps.instruction: Intend in your heart to purify yourself for prayer.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويستحب للمتوضئ أن ينوي الطهارة
ruling.english: It is recommended that the one making wudu intends purification.

steps.title: Say Bismillah
steps.instruction: Say Bismillah as you begin.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وتسمية الله تعالى في ابتداء الوضوء
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: naming Allah at the start of wudu.

steps.title: Wash the hands
steps.instruction: Wash both hands first, before they go into the water. This is a sunnah for one who has just woken from sleep.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وغسل اليدين قبل إدخالها إذا استيقظ المتوضئ من نومه
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: washing the hands before putting them in, when the one making wudu has woken from sleep.

steps.title: Clean the teeth
steps.instruction: Clean your teeth with the siwak.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والسواك والمضمضة والأستنشاق
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.

steps.title: Rinse the mouth
steps.instruction: Rinse your mouth with water.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والسواك والمضمضة والأستنشاق
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.

steps.title: Sniff water into the nose
steps.instruction: Sniff a little water into your nose.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والسواك والمضمضة والأستنشاق
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: the siwak, rinsing the mouth and sniffing water into the nose.

steps.title: Wash the face
steps.instruction: Wash your whole face. This is an obligation of wudu.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فاغسلوا وجوهكم
ruling.english: Wash your faces.

steps.title: Wash the arms
steps.instruction: Wash your arms up to the elbows, elbows included. This is an obligation of wudu.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والمرفقان والكعبان يدخلان في الغسل
ruling.english: The elbows and the ankles are included in the washing.

steps.title: Wipe the head
steps.instruction: Wipe your head with wet hands. Al-Quduri makes the amount of the forelock the obligation.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والمفروض في مسح الرأس مقدار الناصية
ruling.english: What is obligatory in wiping the head is the amount of the forelock.

steps.title: Wipe the ears
steps.instruction: Wipe your ears.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ومسح الأذنين
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: wiping the ears.

steps.title: Wash the feet
steps.instruction: Wash your feet up to the ankles, ankles included. This is an obligation of wudu.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وأرجلكم إلى الكعبين
ruling.english: and your feet up to the ankles.

steps.title: Between the fingers
steps.instruction: Run wet fingers between your fingers, and through the beard if you have one.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وتخليل اللحية والأصابع
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: combing the beard and the fingers with water.

steps.title: Three times
steps.instruction: Wash each limb up to three times.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وتكرار الغسل إلى الثلاث
ruling.english: Among the sunnahs of purification: repeating the washing up to three times.

steps.title: Keep the order
steps.instruction: Wash in the order Allah names them, and begin with the right side.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويرتب الوضوء فيبدأ بما بدأ الله تعالى بذكره وبالميامن
ruling.english: He keeps the wudu in order, beginning with what Allah mentioned first, and with the right side.

steps.title: After wudu
steps.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ
steps.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and that Muhammad is Allah's servant and messenger.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.arabic: مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ يَتَوَضَّأُ فَيُبْلِغُ - أَوْ فَيُسْبِغُ - الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلاَّ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ الثَّمَانِيَةُ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ أَيِّهَا شَاءَ
ruling.english: If any of you performs wudu well and then says: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger, the eight gates of Paradise are opened for him, and he may enter by whichever he wishes.

steps.title: How to stand
steps.instruction: Stand upright to pray. Al-Quduri counts standing among the six obligations of the prayer; he says no more about how to stand.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فرائض الصلاة ستة: التحريمة والقيام والقرءة والركوع والسجود والقعدة الأخيرة مقدار التشهد
ruling.english: The obligations of the prayer are six: the opening takbir, standing, reciting, ruku', sujud, and the last sitting for the length of the tashahhud.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فإذا دخل الرجل في الصلاة كبر ورفع يديه مع التكبير حتى يحاذى بإبهاميه شحمتي أذنيه
ruling.english: When he enters the prayer he says the takbir and raises his hands with it, until his thumbs are level with his earlobes.

steps.title: Fold the hands
steps.instruction: Rest your right hand on your left and place them under your navel.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويعتمد بيده اليمنى على اليسرى ويضعهما تحت سرته
ruling.english: He rests his right hand on his left and places them under his navel.

steps.title: Opening praise (thana')
steps.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
steps.meaning: Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise. Blessed is Your name and exalted Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يقول: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك وتبارك اسمك وتعلى جدك ولا إله غيرك
ruling.english: Then he says: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik…

steps.title: Seeking refuge
steps.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the outcast.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويستعيذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم ويقرأ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويسر بهما
ruling.english: He seeks refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan and reads Bismillah, saying both quietly.

steps.title: Bismillah
steps.meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويستعيذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم ويقرأ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويسر بهما
ruling.english: He seeks refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan and reads Bismillah, saying both quietly.

steps.title: Al-Fatiha
steps.meaning: The Opening, recited in every rak'ah.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يقرأ فاتحة الكتاب وسورة معها أو ثلاث آيات من أي سورة شاء
ruling.english: Then he reads the Fatiha and a surah with it, or three ayahs from any surah he wishes.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: وإذا قال الإمام {ولا الضالين} قال: آمين ويقولها ويخفونها
ruling.english: When the imam says “wa la al-dallin” he says Amin; he says it, and they say it quietly.

steps.title: How to bow
steps.instruction: Bow with your hands on your knees and your fingers spread. Keep your back flat, your head neither raised nor lowered.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يكبر ويركع ويعتمد بيديه على ركبتيه ويفرج أصابعه ويبسط ظهره ولا يرفع رأسه ولا ينكسه
ruling.english: Then he says the takbir and bows, resting his hands on his knees, spreading his fingers, and flattening his back; he neither raises his head nor lowers it.

steps.title: In ruku'
steps.meaning: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويقول في ركوعه: سبحان ربي العظيم ثلاثا وذلك أذناه
ruling.english: In his ruku' he says “Subhana Rabbiya al-'Azim” three times, and that is the least of it.

steps.title: Rising from ruku'
steps.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
steps.meaning: Allah hears the one who praises Him. Our Lord, to You is the praise.

steps.title: How to prostrate
steps.instruction: Rest your hands on the ground, put your face between your palms, and prostrate on your nose and forehead.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: واعتمد بيديه على الأرض ووضع وجهه بين كفيه وسجد على أنفه وجبهته
ruling.english: He rests his hands on the ground, puts his face between his palms, and prostrates on his nose and forehead.

steps.title: In sujud
steps.meaning: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويقول في سجوده: سبحان ربي الأعلى ثلاثا وذلك أدناه
ruling.english: In his sujud he says “Subhana Rabbiya al-A'la” three times, and that is the least of it.

steps.title: How to sit
steps.instruction: Lay your left foot down and sit on it, set your right foot upright with its toes towards the qibla, and rest your hands on your thighs with the fingers spread.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: افترش رجله اليسرى فجلس عليها ونصب اليمنى نصبا ووجه أصابعه نحو القبله ووضع يديه على فخذيه وبسط أصابعة
ruling.english: He lays his left foot down and sits on it, sets the right one upright, points his toes towards the qibla, rests his hands on his thighs and spreads his fingers.

steps.title: Tashahhud
steps.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
steps.meaning: Greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: والتشهد أن يقول: التحيات لله والصلوات والطيبات السلام عليك أيها النبي ورحمة الله وبركاته السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله ولا يزيد على هذا في القعدة الأولى
ruling.english: The tashahhud is to say: al-tahiyyatu lillah… and he adds nothing to this in the first sitting.

steps.title: Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
steps.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
steps.meaning: O Allah, send prayers on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent prayers on Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فإذا جلس في آخر الصلاة جلس كما في الأولى وتشهد وصلى على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
ruling.english: When he sits at the end of the prayer he sits as in the first, says the tashahhud, and sends prayers on the Prophet ﷺ.

steps.title: Closing salam
steps.meaning: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يسلم عن يمينه فيقول: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وعن يساره مثل ذلك
ruling.english: Then he gives salam to his right, saying “as-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah”, and to his left the same.

steps.title: Open and recite
steps.instruction: Say the takbir with your hands raised and fold them. Then thana', ta'awwudh, Bismillah, the Fatiha and Amin, and a surah with it.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يقرأ فاتحة الكتاب وسورة معها أو ثلاث آيات من أي سورة شاء
ruling.english: Then he reads the Fatiha and a surah with it, or three ayahs from any surah he wishes.

steps.title: Aloud or quietly
steps.instruction: As imam, recite aloud in Fajr and in the first two rak'ahs of Maghrib and 'Isha. After the first two rak'ahs, recite quietly.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويجهز بالقرءة في الفجر والركعتين الأوليين من المغرب والعشاء إن كان إماما ويخفي القراءة فيما بعد الأوليين
ruling.english: He recites aloud in Fajr and in the first two rak'ahs of Maghrib and 'Isha if he is the imam, and recites quietly after the first two.

steps.title: Bow and rise
steps.instruction: Say the takbir and bow. Say Subhana Rabbiya al-'Azim, then rise.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يكبر ويركع
ruling.english: Then he says the takbir and bows.

steps.title: Two prostrations
steps.instruction: Prostrate and say Subhana Rabbiya al-A'la. Rise with the takbir and sit calmly, then say the takbir and prostrate again.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يرفع رأسه ويكبر فإذا اطمأن جالسا كبر وسجد
ruling.english: Then he raises his head and says the takbir; when he is settled sitting, he says the takbir and prostrates.

steps.title: Rise for the second rak'ah
steps.instruction: Say the takbir and stand on the fronts of your feet, without sitting and without leaning on your hands.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فإذا اطمأن ساجدا كبر واستوى قائما على صدور قدميه ولا يقعد ولا يعتمد بيديه على الأرض
ruling.english: When he is settled in prostration he says the takbir and stands on the fronts of his feet; he does not sit and does not lean on his hands on the ground.

steps.title: The second rak'ah
steps.instruction: Pray it as the first, but with no thana', no ta'awwudh, and hands raised only at the opening takbir.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويفعل في الركعة الثانية مثل ما فعل في الأولى إلا أنه لا يستفتح ولا يتعوذ ولا يرفع يديه إلا في التكبير الأولى
ruling.english: He does in the second rak'ah what he did in the first, except that he does not open with the thana', does not seek refuge, and does not raise his hands except at the first takbir.

steps.title: First sitting
steps.instruction: Sit as you learnt and say the tashahhud, adding nothing to it.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ولا يزيد على هذا في القعدة الأولى
ruling.english: He adds nothing to this in the first sitting.

steps.title: The last rak'ahs
steps.instruction: In the last two rak'ahs recite only the Fatiha.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ويقرأ في الركعتين الأخريين الكتاب خاصة
ruling.english: He reads only the Fatiha in the last two rak'ahs.

steps.title: Last sitting
steps.instruction: Sit as in the first sitting, say the tashahhud and send prayers on the Prophet ﷺ.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: فإذا جلس في آخر الصلاة جلس كما في الأولى وتشهد وصلى على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
ruling.english: When he sits at the end of the prayer he sits as in the first, says the tashahhud, and sends prayers on the Prophet ﷺ.

steps.title: Ask Allah
steps.instruction: Ask with words like the Qur'an's or the du'as handed down, never with words like everyday speech.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ودعا بما شاء بما يشبه ألفاظ القرآن والأدعيه المأثورة ولا يدعو بما يشبه كلام الناس
ruling.english: He asks for what he wishes, with words like those of the Qur'an and the handed-down du'as, and does not ask with words like people's speech.

steps.title: Give the salam
steps.instruction: Say the closing salam to your right, then the same to your left.

ruling.author: Abu al-Husayn al-Quduri (d. 428 AH)
ruling.arabic: ثم يسلم عن يمينه فيقول: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وعن يساره مثل ذلك
ruling.english: Then he gives salam to his right, saying “as-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah”, and to his left the same.

steps.title: Asking forgiveness
steps.meaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness. Say it three times.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 591 (sunnah.com/muslim:591)
ruling.arabic: اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلاَثًا
ruling.english: He asked forgiveness three times.

steps.title: You are Peace
steps.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
steps.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of Glory and Honour.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 591 (sunnah.com/muslim:591)
ruling.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
ruling.english: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer he asked forgiveness three times and said: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace; blessed are You, Possessor of Glory and Honour.

steps.title: Tasbih, 33 times
steps.meaning: Glory be to Allah. Say it 33 times.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.arabic: تُسَبِّحُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ
ruling.english: Say “Glory be to Allah” thirty-three times.

steps.title: Tahmid, 33 times
steps.meaning: All praise is for Allah. Say it 33 times.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.arabic: وَتَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ
ruling.english: Say “All praise is for Allah” thirty-three times.

steps.title: Takbir, 33 times
steps.meaning: Allah is the greatest. Say it 33 times.

ruling.author: Imam Muslim (d. 261 AH)
ruling.where: Kitab al-Masajid wa Mawadi' al-Salah, hadith 595a (sunnah.com/muslim:595a)
ruling.arabic: وَتُكَبِّرُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ
ruling.english: Say “Allah is the greatest” thirty-three times.
